wizard.title: Set up Spec Studio
wizard.description: First run on this machine: choose ports, where to store data, and connect Google (optional). You can change these later in Settings › System.
wizard.googleOptional: Optional. Only needed to save specs to Google Drive; you can add it later.
wizard.reviewHint: Check everything before saving. Secrets are shown masked.
wizard.doneBody: Settings were saved for this project.

port.label: Dev port
port.hint: Port used when running in development mode (1024–65535).

portStart.label: Production port
portStart.hint: Port used when running the build; must differ from the dev port.

dataDir.label: Data folder
dataDir.hint: Inside the project's .spec-studio folder, e.g. data or /data.
dataDir.outside: Currently using a folder outside the project. Leave empty to keep it.

secretKey.label: Encryption key
secretKey.hint: Leave empty to let the app create a key on this machine. When moving machines, reuse the same key to read saved secrets.
secretKey.locked: An encryption key is already set. It can't be changed here to avoid losing saved secrets.

fields.googleHint: Takes effect right after saving, no server restart needed.

restart.title: Restart the server
restart.body: Ports, data storage or the encryption key changed. Restart the server to apply them. Google settings already use the new values.

import.title: Import settings from a .env file
import.description: Pick an existing .env file or paste its contents. Values are filled into the form so you can review them before saving.
import.empty: No usable settings found in this content.

system.description: Ports, data storage and Google connection for this project.
